Tired of your AI coding assistant generating sloppy Rust code stuffed with unwrap() and public fields? 🦀🤖

Meet BeautifulRust: the ultimate toolkit designed to transform AI models into strict, idiomatic systems programming experts. 

While AI code generation is accelerating development, developers waste countless hours refactoring AI-generated Rust that compiles but completely violates memory safety idioms, lacks error documentation, or overuses unwraps. 

BeautifulRust bridges the gap between AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and production-grade, memory-safe Rust development. It provides a comprehensive suite of agent skills and drop-in clippy configurations distilled from industry-standard style guides and effective patterns.

Key features include:
✨ rust-best-practices agent skill that steers AI coding assistants toward idiomatic, robust, and maintainable Rust code during generation.
🔍 rust-review agent skill that analyzes existing code, crates, or diffs to produce prioritized reports citing exact rule violations and fixes.
🔄 rust-port agent skill that safely translates C, C++, Python, Go, or JavaScript code into idiomatic Rust by porting tests first and mapping legacy types properly.
🛡️ Drop-in clippy configuration and lints config that enforce machine-checkable rules like zero unwrap usage, mandatory safety comments, and proper error documentation in CI.

Whether you are enforcing strict idiomatic standards within AI-assisted microservices or securely porting legacy C or Python codebases to memory-safe Rust, this repository ensures your AI assistant natively produces clean, production-ready code that passes strict CI linting on the first try.

Check it out on GitHub:
https://github.com/morganlinton/BeautifulRust

Stop treating open-weight LLMs like uninterpretable black boxes. 🧠✨

If you are an AI engineer or researcher trying to debug hallucinations, spot unintended biases, or figure out why your model is behaving a certain way, you need to see what is happening under the hood. 

Neuron Explorer (lyramakesmusic/neuron-explorer) is a steering-first, 3D mechanistic interpretability tool built specifically for Qwen3.5-4B that lets you inspect and manipulate internal model representations in real time. 

Here is what you get out of the box:

🪐 3D Interactive Visualization: Map layers, attention, and MLP neurons with spatial clustering based on down-projection columns.
⚡ Automated Sweep Pipelines: Utilize a specialized vLLM steering fork to capture activation extremes, word-cluster masses, and next-token shifts.
🎮 Live Steered Chat: Push neurons up and down, observe steered rollouts, and test neuron effects on custom text with MPS, CUDA, or CPU backends.
🤖 Claude MCP Server Integration: Let an AI agent read neurons, manipulate the 3D map, execute live inferences, and run shell or file tools.

Bridge the gap between academic interpretability whitepapers and hands-on developer tooling. Audit specific neurons, debug generations through live steering, and build safer LLM pipelines today.

Check out the repo and drop a star if you want to crack open the black box:
https://github.com/lyramakesmusic/neuron-explorer

Tired of system-level ads, forced marketing recommendations, and relentless telemetry baked into modern OEM skins like HyperOS, ColorOS, OriginOS, and MagicOS? 

Say goodbye to OEM bloat without needing to root your device, unlock your bootloader, or flash custom ROMs that break your daily OTA system updates. 

Introducing Android Ad Cleaner: a practical, non-root debloater and ad-cleaning toolkit built for modern Android power users and developers. 

Here is what makes it a game-changer:

🤖 AI Agent & Automation Ready: Features multi-modal execution modes including a native desktop GUI for macOS and Windows, a Python CLI, and seamless integration with AI coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Trae via dedicated markdown manifests.
🧠 Smart UI Automation Engine: Powered by uiautomator2 to dynamically read your screen, navigate buried settings menus, toggle specific switches, and manage notification channels without blindly disabling essential system packages.
⚖️ Granular & Reversible Tweaks: Safely handles ad components using pm suspend with explicit user consent, isolates quickapps, and cleans up promotional store slots while keeping crucial widgets like weather and delivery tracking fully functional.
🔍 Automated Diagnostics: Includes robust error handling, automatic backup state snapshots, and one-click GitHub issue reporting with privacy-scrubbed logs.

For developers, it also serves as a fantastic reference architecture for building cross-platform Python desktop apps with pywebview and PyInstaller, paired with advanced device automation via ADB.

Ready to clean up your device programmatically? Check out the repository and drop a star if it saves your daily workflow:
https://github.com/rddmwmddr/android-ad-cleaner

Want to automate your entire PR lifecycle using AI agents? Theo Browne just open-sourced his daily Claude Code and Codex skill stack.

Managing the full software development lifecycle with LLM coding assistants usually comes with a lot of friction. T-Stack solves this by providing a curated collection of agent skills that automate complex, multi-step workflows like end-to-end pull request creation, automated code reviews, multi-model consensus checks, and CI babysitting directly within your development environment.

Here is what is under the hood:

🚀 Full-Send and Full-Stop Automation: Automatically takes code changes, proves them, reviews them, files PRs, handles CI checks, fixes real issues, and merges them with minimal human intervention.

🧠 Multi-Model Consensus Loops: Implements council and sol-loop patterns to cross-examine code changes across different LLM providers until they reach an agreement.

📋 Intelligent PR Management: Includes specialized skills for modernizing old branches, filing problem-centric PR descriptions rather than raw file inventories, and babysitting CI pipelines.

🛡️ Graceful Fallbacks: Integrates natively with advanced code features while gracefully falling back to standard tools when needed.

Stop wasting hours on manual PR overhead, context-switching, and boilerplate code reviews. Delegate your repetitive git and GitHub workflows to autonomous agents and let your team focus on building.

Check out the repo and drop a star:
https://github.com/t3dotgg/tstack

Tired of dry, text-heavy vocabulary memorization that just doesn't stick? 

Meet Word Atlas, an open-source IELTS vocabulary learning app that pairs 7,298 AI-generated illustrations and native audio with the FSRS spaced repetition algorithm.

Word Atlas solves the problem of boring flashcards by embedding words into rich visual, auditory, and contextual environments. Built with a production-ready React 19 and Vite offline-first architecture, it is a masterclass in modern EdTech engineering.

Key features include:
✨ FSRS Integration: Uses the ts-fsrs algorithm for mathematically optimized memory retention and review scheduling.
🌌 WebGL2 Star Map: An interactive vocabulary galaxy rendering your learning progress across 19 topics with dynamic zooming and rotation.
📦 Massive Multimodal Dataset: Over 7,298 CEFR-aligned entries, custom WebP illustrations, and more than 22,000 audio files.

Whether you want to study advanced React 19 patterns, explore custom WebGL2 rendering techniques, or extract the CC BY 4.0 dataset to build your own custom language-learning tools, this repo is packed with value.

Check it out on GitHub:
https://github.com/designfuchen/word-atlas
